papers.title_en: Scalable Iterative Multi-Agent Path Finding under Turn Constraints
papers.authors: Zheyu Tao, Chunlong Yu, Yicheng Hu
papers.evidence: 面向多移动机器人系统的转弯约束可扩展多智能体路径规划
papers.tldr: 面向带转向动作的多智能体路径规划MAPF_T，现有搜索法因转向约束计算负担重，优先级继承虽可扩展却难直接处理转向导致的节点占用依赖。本文提出PIBT*_T迭代求解器，保留PIBT轻量单步规划，并加入转向依赖、局部死锁、活锁与重复推挤处理机制。标准基准上可数秒求解多达1000智能体，ADG执行仿真与柔性制造案例显示转向感知规划降低实际makespan，TurtleBot4实验验证可行性。
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale multi-mobile-robot systems require fast and reliable path planning under realistic motion constraints. Multi-Agent Path Finding with turn actions (MAPF$_T$) explicitly models orientation changes and turn-induced delays, but these constraints increase the computational burden of search-based methods. Priority-inheritance-based planning offers a highly scalable alternative, yet directly extending it to MAPF$_T$ is nontrivial because turn actions break the immediate node-vacation assumption underlying conventional priority inheritance. To address this challenge, this paper proposes PIBT$^*_T$, an efficient iterative solver for MAPF$_T$. PIBT$^*_T$ advances scalable multi-agent coordination by preserving the lightweight single-timestep planning mechanism of Priority Inheritance with Backtracking (PIBT), while introducing dedicated mechanisms to handle turn-induced dependencies, local deadlocks, livelock, and inefficient repeated pushing. Experiments on standard MAPF benchmarks show that PIBT$^*_T$ achieves high success rates and strong scalability, solving instances with up to 1000 agents within seconds. For realistic engineering environments, Action Dependency Graph (ADG)-based execution simulation and a flexible manufacturing system case study show that turn-aware planning better reflects robot execution and reduces actual makespan compared with classical MAPF planning. Experiments with TurtleBot4 robots further validate the practical feasibility of the proposed method.

papers.title_en: Bridging Continuous-Time MAPF and Industrial AGV Fleet Coordination with Lazy Priority-Based Search
papers.authors: Federico Signorile, Raffaele Carli, Alessandro Bertogli, Roberto Olmi, Sven Koenig, Mariagrazia Dotoli
papers.evidence: 面向工业AGV车队协调与仓储应用的连续时间多智能体路径规划
papers.tldr: 工业AGV车队需在复杂路网中做连续时间避碰，但高连通冗余路网使MAPF_R求解与多智能体交互代价高。作者形式化AGV-MAPF_R-CTC，并重访CPBS的安全区间约束与提前解检测。进一步分析优先级搜索空间，提出惰性物化高层节点的Lazy-CPBS，避免未扩展兄弟节点的底层搜索。标准基准与数字孪生导入的工业路网实验表明，CPBS类求解器可扩展到最优MAPF_R难以处理的智能体规模，Lazy-CPBS显著降低开销并给出更稳健的运行时权衡。
papers.abstract_en: Continuous-time multi-agent path finding on roadmaps (MAPF$_R$) offers a principled way to coordinate robot fleets with geometric collision avoidance, yet its deployment on industrial automated guided vehicle (AGV) infrastructures remains challenging, as highly connected and redundant roadmaps amplify both safe-interval reasoning and multi-agent interaction handling. To bridge this gap, we formalize AGV-MAPF$_R$-CTC, a configuration-space variant of MAPF$_R$ with precomputed continuous-time conflicts that enables the reuse of MAPF$_R$ solvers for AGV fleet coordination with minimal changes. We then revisit continuous-time priority-based search (CPBS), identifying the boundary conditions required by its safe interval path planning (SIPP) low-level planner under priority-induced constraints and enabling earlier solution detection. As a central contribution, we analyze the structure of the priority search space, clarifying which agents are affected by each priority refinement and when replanning can be avoided. Building on this analysis, we introduce a novel algorithm, Lazy-CPBS, which materializes high-level nodes lazily: a child's plans are computed only when it is expanded, so siblings that are never expanded cost no low-level search. Experiments on standard MAPF benchmarks and on industrial AGV roadmaps imported from a proprietary digital-twin simulator show that CPBS-based solvers remain effective well beyond the agent counts reachable by optimal MAPF$_R$ solvers, while Lazy-CPBS substantially reduces CPBS overhead and offers the most consistent robustness/runtime trade-off across industrial layouts.

papers.title_en: Asymmetric Decomposition for Multi-Agent Path Finding with Unassigned Agents
papers.authors: Xi Jin, Chen Qian, Renjun Zhang, Guowei Wu, Xiaobo Li, Jun Jiang, Weiwei Shang
papers.evidence: 基于冲突搜索的含未指派智能体多智能体路径规划
papers.tldr: 针对含未分配智能体的多智能体路径规划，未分配机器人可能阻挡活跃机器人，而统一停靠又会带来多余移动。FOCBS 用 CBS 搜索已分配智能体路径，并以最小费用流 oracle 为无目标任务智能体规划路径；当冲突阻塞时，通过流冲突分支把最小割阻塞者转为已分配智能体约束。实验表明该方法可随未分配智能体数量扩展，相比丢弃不可完成路径显著解出更多实例并保持最优性，物理实验中车队移动较停车协调基线减少40.8%。
papers.abstract_en: Robots without assigned tasks may obstruct active robots, while routing them to designated parking locations can cause unnecessary travel. This article proposes flow-oracle conflict-based search (FOCBS) for Multi-Agent Path Finding with unassigned agents (MAPF-UA). FOCBS searches over assigned-agent paths using conflict-based search (CBS) and routes targetless unassigned agents through a min-cost flow oracle. When the selected assigned-agent paths leave unassigned agents no collision-free paths, flow-conflict branching converts min-cut blockers into assigned-agent constraints, which guide the search without excluding optimal solutions. A batched zero-cost warm start accelerates the oracle, and start-avoiding tie-breaking reduces unassigned-agent movement. For feasible instances on finite graphs, we prove termination and global minimization of assigned-agent sum of service time, measured by last-arrival times. Unassigned-agent movement is minimized conditional on the selected assigned-agent paths, without a global lexicographic optimality guarantee. Benchmark experiments show that FOCBS scales well with the number of unassigned agents, and ablation studies show that, compared with discarding non-completable assigned-agent paths, flow-conflict branching solves substantially more instances while retaining optimality. Simulation and physical-robot experiments demonstrate plan executability, with laboratory tests reducing fleet travel by 40.8% relative to the parking-based coordination baseline. The source code and related resources are available at https://github.com/Chin-hsi/focbs

papers.title_en: MAWAM: A Multi-Agent World-Action Model for Coordinated Manipulation
papers.authors: Xianzhe Fan, Chi-Pin Huang, Fu-En Yang, Jing Wang, Yecheng Wu, Yu-Cheng Chou, Johan Bjorck, Linxi "Jim" Fan, Jan Kautz, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang, Zhiding Yu, Hengshuang Zhao, Zhiqi Li
papers.evidence: 多智能体世界-动作模型联合预测团队动作与共享物理未来
papers.tldr: 多机器人协同操作需要同时预测队友动作与其共同造成的物理未来，但现有方法难以联合建模。MAWAM 基于预训练单机器人世界-动作骨干，通过跨智能体注意力联合去噪各机器人的动作与未来视角 token，并保留独立控制接口。真实机器人三项任务平均成功率达 67.8%，比 MA-VLA 高 18.9 个百分点；仿真八任务平均成功率 90.3%。消融显示跨智能体注意力和团队阶段未来视频监督对协同控制至关重要。
papers.abstract_en: Every move in a robot team changes the world in which its teammates must act. Coordinated manipulation therefore calls for predicting the team's actions together with the physical future they jointly create. We introduce MAWAM, a multi-agent world-action model that jointly generates each robot's future views and executable action chunks in a single sample. Built from a pretrained single-robot world-action backbone, MAWAM jointly denoises all robots' action and future-view tokens through cross-agent attention, while preserving a separate control interface for each robot. MAWAM achieves the highest success on all three real-robot tasks (laundry-bag collection, bath-towel folding, and umbrella handover), with 67.8% mean success, 18.9 percentage points above MA-VLA trained on the same demonstrations and cameras. In simulation, MAWAM reaches 90.3% mean success on eight tasks with teams of up to four arms. Ablations show that cross-agent attention and team-stage future-video supervision both improve coordinated control: without attention, a four-arm relay falls from 95.0% to 39.0%, and without this supervision, Place Food falls from 78.0% to 47.0%.

papers.authors: Yefim Nudelman, Dor Atzmon, Tom Tirer
papers.evidence: 面向多机器人运动规划与避碰的地图条件轨迹扩散
papers.tldr: 多机器人运动规划需同时避开环境障碍与机器人间碰撞。SCTD将位置感知占用token经交叉注意力保留在时序U-Net中，并用端点修复约束起终点，以单机器人示范训练地图条件轨迹生成器。结合CBS约束重规划协调多机轨迹。在15000个留出任务上成功率高于引导扩散基线，硬绕行任务增益最大，轨迹更平滑，并支持最多15机器人团队。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-Robot Motion Planning (MRMP) requires trajectories that avoid environmental obstacles and collisions between robots in a shared workspace. Diffusion-based planners often address obstacle avoidance through sampling-time guidance, while some conditioned approaches aggregate map geometry into a global representation. We present Spatially Conditioned Trajectory Diffusion (SCTD), a map-conditioned trajectory generator for multi-robot planning. SCTD retains multiple position-aware occupancy tokens accessed through cross-attention throughout a temporal U-Net, with hard endpoint inpainting enforcing start and goal states. One model trained on single-robot demonstrations across procedural environments generates obstacle-aware trajectories without sampling-time obstacle-cost guidance. High-level Conflict-Based Search (CBS) coordinates these trajectories through constrained replanning, retaining inter-agent guidance during sampling and reusing the model across workspace layouts and team sizes. Experiments assess single-robot success and trajectory quality, generalization to unfamiliar layouts with added obstacles, and coordinated multi-robot planning. On 15,000 held-out tasks, SCTD achieves higher success than the evaluated guided diffusion baseline, with the largest gains on hard-detour tasks, while trajectory-quality comparisons show smoother trajectories. Conditioning ablations show higher success with spatial tokens than with a global map embedding, and map-replacement tests demonstrate dependence on the supplied geometry. The resulting multi-robot system achieves higher team success than the compared diffusion baselines, with experiments covering teams of up to 15 robots.

papers.title_en: MAWAM: Joint Imagination for Collaborative Robot Manipulation with a Multi-Agent World Action Model
papers.authors: Rongze Tang, Chenyu Zhou, Jianjie Fang, Ziming Liu, Zhaolu Wang, Ziyou Wang, Xvyuan Liu, Wei Wu, Chen Gao, Yong Li, Zhibo Chen
papers.evidence: 面向多机器人协同操作的多智能体世界动作模型
papers.tldr: 现有世界动作模型擅长单机器人操作，却难以支撑多机器人跨工作空间、时序耦合和异构本体的协作。MAWAM联合预测多本体未来观测并解码各智能体动作，借助智能体轴课程、统一因果序列中的联合自注意力及角色/身份/本体编码实现时空对齐与角色绑定。作者构建MA-Bench与MA-Task Harness，覆盖七类任务。实验取得82.7%平均联合成功率，较最强基线高30.7%，并在真实异构机器人团队实现实时闭环协作。
papers.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) excel at robot manipulation by imagining future observations and decoding actions from them, yet remain confined to a single embodied agent. In practice, manipulation often requires multiple robots to collaborate across disjoint workspaces, coupled timing, and heterogeneous embodiments. Such coordination demands both spatiotemporal alignment of future interactions and awareness of individual embodiment and role identities, whereas existing decentralized per-robot policies, flat centralized models, and multi-robot VLAs fail to unite both. To bridge this gap, we present MAWAM, a multi-agent world action model that jointly predicts the future observations of multiple embodiments and decodes each agent's actions from them for collaborative manipulation. Through an agent-axis curriculum, MAWAM expands a single-agent WAM along an agent dimension to coordinate teams under shared weights. Within one unified causal sequence, joint self-attention spans all agents to spatiotemporally align their imagined futures, while hierarchical language, identity encodings, and embodiment masks bind each stream to its role, identity, and embodiment. We further formalize multi-agent-necessary manipulation along three axes (why, when, and who) and develop MA-Task Harness, a coding-agent pipeline where mutually constraining generators and evaluators co-evolve customizable simulation-data and evaluation packages. Using this pipeline, we build MA-Bench across all axes with seven tasks, pairing joint success rate with role and collaboration scores for fine-grained analysis. On MA-Bench, MAWAM reaches 82.7% mean joint success, 30.7% above the strongest baseline, and achieves real-time closed-loop collaboration on a real heterogeneous robot team.

papers.authors: Jiarui Li, Runyu Zhang, Gioele Zardini
papers.evidence: 面向仓储机器人集群的动力学多智能体运动规划
papers.tldr: 大规模机器人集群协同需满足动力学、速度与加速度边界，并保证连续时间无碰撞；现有kinodynamic规划器在搜索中或后加约束，限制规模与速度。TAKT在搜索前处理动力学，将双积分器机器人化为晶格搜索，用解析间隙界和闭式卷积把离散计划转成动态可行、连续避碰轨迹，并以diamond形式支持单tick侧让、适配PIBT与LaCAM。50机器人时2D/3D较最强基线快逾2000倍/100倍，成本不劣；2D秒级规划约千机、3D数十秒，可实时重规划上千机。
papers.abstract_en: Coordinating large robot fleets, from warehouses to quadrotor swarms, requires collision-free trajectories that satisfy dynamic constraints and stay within speed and acceleration bounds. Existing kinodynamic multi-agent planners enforce these bounds during the search or through trajectory optimization after it, which limits fleet size and speed. We present Tickwise Actions to Kinodynamic Trajectories (TAKT), a framework that accounts for the dynamics before the search and reduces planning to a lattice search for double-integrator robots. TAKT analytically bounds the clearance lost when a discrete plan is smoothed and reserves this margin on the lattice. A closed-form convolution provably converts any valid plan into dynamically feasible trajectories with continuous-time collision avoidance. For robots spanning many lattice vertices, we introduce a diamond formulation that permits one-tick sideways yielding and adapt the Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) solvers PIBT and LaCAM to it. With 50 robots, our planners run over 2,000 times faster than the strongest baseline in 2D halls and over 100 times in 3D, with comparable or lower makespan and cost. They plan about a thousand robots in seconds in 2D, and tens of seconds in 3D, and replan up to a thousand robots in real time.

papers.title_en: Seeing Together, Acting Apart: Shared Environmental Understanding for Multi-Robot Navigation
papers.authors: Haihong Hao, Lei Chen, Mingfei Han, Chenglong Yan, Dong An, Yuqiang Yang, Changlin Li, Minghao Guo, Salman Khan, Xiaojun Chang
papers.evidence: 由多机器人自中心观测构建的共享潜世界模型
papers.tldr: 多机器人具身系统通常靠协调动作、共享轨迹或联合策略来协作。本文提出“共享环境理解”，在决策前先把各机器人局部自我中心观测聚合为共享潜在世界模型，将协作从策略空间转移到表征空间。为此提出SEER框架，用时空相似度检索共享记忆，并以预测式潜在世界模型编码，再把结果作为token注入下游导航智能体。实验表明其能捕捉动作相关环境结构，稳定提升多类智能体的导航表现。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-robot embodied systems are typically designed to collaborate by coordinating actions, sharing trajectories, or learning joint policies. We ask a complementary question: can collaboration emerge before decision-making, by first building a shared understanding of the environment? We introduce Shared Environmental Understanding, a policy-agnostic representation that aggregates partial egocentric observations from multiple robots into a shared latent world model. This shifts collaboration from the policy space to the representation space, enabling decentralized decision-making with shared environmental context. To this end, we propose Shared Environment Encoding and Retrieval (SEER), a framework that organizes multi-robot observations into a shared memory, retrieves relevant context via spatio-temporal similarity, and encodes it using a predictive latent world model. The resulting representations are injected into downstream navigation agents as tokens. Experimental results demonstrate that SEER captures action-relevant environmental structure and consistently improves navigation performance across both specialized VLN agents and general vision-language model agents, while preserving single-agent capabilities.

papers.title_en: Cooperative Mobile Manipulation using Learned Dynamical Systems
papers.authors: Saray Bakker, Wendelin Böhmer, Javier Alonso-Mora
papers.evidence: 协作移动操作多机器人协调与避碰
papers.tldr: 针对多移动机械臂协同中的全身避障与行为保持问题，论文提出CALDS框架，将单智能体示范学习到的动态系统扩展为协同执行。该方法通过协同策略选择筛选兼容策略组合，并利用时间适配在保持原行为空间结构与收敛性的同时实现无碰撞协作。在辅助穿衣、餐厅清洁服务、抽屉开取与物品放置三类场景中，CALDS提高了任务成功率，支持安全同步执行并维持示范行为保真度。该工作为复用学习技能实现多机协同提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative mobile manipulation requires robots to coordinate their motions while ensuring whole-body collision avoidance and preserving task-relevant behaviors. We propose CALDS (Cooperative Adaptation of Learned Dynamical Systems), a framework that enables mobile manipulators to adapt learned single-agent behaviors for coordinated execution. Building on individual dynamical systems (DSs) learned from demonstrations, CALDS enables cooperative adaptation through two key components: Cooperative Policy Selection, which identifies compatible combinations of learned policies, and Temporal Adaptation, which ensures collision-free cooperation while preserving the spatial structure and convergence properties of the original behaviors. We evaluate CALDS across three diverse scenarios: assistive dressing, restaurant cleaning and serving, and drawer opening and object placement. Quantitative results demonstrate its effectiveness in improving task success and enabling safe, coordinated simultaneous execution while maintaining fidelity to demonstrated behaviors.

papers.title_en: Hybrid Optimization-Generative Motion Planning for Multiagent Affine Formations
papers.authors: Zhonggang Li, Hongyu Zhou, Raj Thilak Rajan
papers.evidence: 基于优化-生成混合框架的多智能体编队运动规划
papers.tldr: 多智能体编队穿越受限环境依赖高质量参考轨迹，传统约束优化在高维联合轨迹上计算困难。本文面向仿射编队提出优化-生成混合运动规划框架，将任务建模为约束最大后验估计，用单智能体扩散先验解耦多智能体目标，并交替投影梯度下降严格满足仿射几何与安全约束。仿真表明规划平滑、无碰撞且易被分布式控制器跟踪，多项指标优于先进规划器。
papers.abstract_en: Formation maneuver control enables a multiagent system to cooperatively navigate through constrained environments in collective motion. While various formation controllers exist, they rely heavily on high-quality and dynamically feasible reference trajectories provided a priori, making formation motion planning (FMP) essential. To address the computational challenges for high-dimensional joint trajectories faced by conventional constrained optimization-based solutions, this paper introduces a hybrid optimization-generative framework with a focus on affine formations, which provide the necessary spatial flexibility. By formulating the planning task as a constrained Maximum-a-Posteriori estimation, we decouple multiagent objectives to leverage pre-trained single-agent diffusion priors for dynamic feasibility, obstacle avoidance, and smoothness. We then interleave the generative process with projected gradient descent (PGD) to strictly enforce affine geometric constraints with safety guarantees. Simulations demonstrate that our framework generates highly smooth, collision-free plans that are readily trackable by common distributed controllers and outperforms state-of-the-art planners in various metrics.

papers.title_en: Even Loose Proximity Constraints Make Makespan-optimal Unlabeled Multi-agent Pathfinding Hard
papers.evidence: 最小完工时间无标号多智能体路径规划复杂性
papers.tldr: rCUMAPF要求可互换智能体在图中始终保持有限范围通信并聚成单组，但最优makespan求解复杂度在中间邻近范围下尚不清楚。本文聚焦2≤r的中间情形，通过归约证明即使只判断是否存在makespan不超过2的解也已NP难。该困难性覆盖2≤r=O(|V|^{1-ε})，并推出labeled版本同样NP难。这表明宽松邻近约束仍使最优无标签多智能体路径规划本质困难。
papers.abstract_en: We study $r$-Connected Unlabeled Multi-agent Pathfinding ($r$CUMAPF), a variant of MAPF where interchangeable agents have a proximity range $r\in \mathbb{N}$, and agents must form a single group in a given graph $G$ through limited-range communication at all times. The problem arises in fundamental applications such as self-reconfiguration and platooning, while standard MAPF does not capture proximity constraints. For the problem of finding a makespan-optimal solution, prior work shows NP-hardness for $r=1$ and polynomial-time solvability when $r$ is sufficiently large; the complexity for the intermediate case $2\le r$ is largely unknown. To narrow this gap, we show that finding a solution to $r$CUMAPF with makespan at most $2$ is NP-hard for $2\le r= O(|V|^{1-\varepsilon})$, where $0<\varepsilon\le 1$ is a fixed constant and $|V|$ is the number of vertices. As a consequence, we show that the labeled analogue of $r$CUMAPF is also NP-hard under the same condition.

papers.title_en: DMPT-Swarm: A Directional Mass-Preserving Transform for Decentralized Swarm Navigation in Obstacle Environments
papers.authors: Jacob Lee, Samuel Sutphin, Haroon Malik, Chang Liu, Pingping Zhu
papers.evidence: 去中心化集群导航与多智能体协调
papers.tldr: 针对障碍环境中集群导航依赖通信且易陷局部最优的问题，本文在给定GMM宏观轨迹下提出去中心化微观控制框架。先用Wasserstein-2度量下的MVN仿射传输生成无通信的障碍感知参考位置，再提出DMPT在保持方向结构的同时修正径向传输以融入障碍影响。各智能体基于变换参考独立运行局部APF控制器，降低通信与计算负担。仿真表明该方法相较传统APF在效率和避障上更优。
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a decentralized microscopic control framework for swarm navigation in obstacle environments, given a precomputed macroscopic trajectory represented by Gaussian mixture models (GMMs). To generate obstacle-aware reference locations without inter-agent communication, we first employ affine transport between multivariate normal (MVN) distributions under the Wasserstein-2 metric. We then propose a directional mass-preserving transform (DMPT) to incorporate obstacle effects by modifying radial transport while preserving directional structure. Based on the transformed references, a local artificial potential field (APF)-based controller is applied for navigation. Each agent operates independently, reducing communication and computational burden. Simulation results demonstrate improved efficiency and obstacle avoidance compared to conventional APF-based methods

papers.title_en: Coordination of Heterogeneous Teams with Uncertain Task Requirements
papers.evidence: 协调异构多智能体团队的分层规划器
papers.tldr: 异构多智能体在任务需求未知时，需同时完成需求发现、执行与调度，协调难度大。本文提出分层规划器，用图神经网络策略为智能体分配动作，并以最短路算法规划到动作位置的路径。核心是包含智能体、任务、能力与动作的CAAT图表示规划上下文。实验表明该学习规划器能联合协调异构团队，比独立优化发现与执行更快完成任务，并可在未微调下零样本迁移到更复杂的室内地图。
papers.abstract_en: Coordinating a team of heterogeneous agents to complete tasks with unknown requirements is a challenging multi-agent planning problem. Agents differ in their ability to discover task requirements and in their ability to engage tasks, so the planner must coordinate task discovery, execution, and staging. This paper introduces a hierarchical planner that uses a graph neural network policy to assign actions to agents, then finds a path to the action's location using a shortest-path algorithm. The central part of our approach is the CAAT graph, which is a graph representation of the planning context consisting of the agents, tasks, capabilities, and actions. We demonstrate that our learned planner can jointly coordinate a heterogeneous team to simultaneously discover task requirements and complete tasks in a shorter time compared to baselines that optimize task discovery and task engagement independently. Furthermore, we show that our policy can zero-shot plan on out-of-distribution settings by training only on an outdoor map then transferring without finetuning to an indoor map with more agents, tasks, and capabilities than seen during training.

papers.title_en: RoboTeam: Benchmarking Vision-Based Multi-Agent Control of Many Robot Arms in Real Time
papers.authors: Changxuan Fan, Zhongwei Xie, Boyi Zhang, Shaoli Hu, Chang Xu, Xiyu Ren, Yufei Li, Qiao Xiao, Huihao Jing, Kawai Chung, Wenbin Hu, Hongyu Luo, Lingyun Xie, Yisen Gao, Chunyang Li, Haoyu Huang, Wuganjing Song, Yuxuan Liu, Chiu Yeung Tang, Fangneng Zhan, Xi Yang
papers.evidence: 4至16个机械臂的实时多智能体协同控制
papers.tldr: 现有机器人臂基准多只测一两台、短任务，且常暂停世界或给出真值位置。RoboTeam在仿真中让智能体仅凭相机图像实时控制4至16台机械臂，完成36项长时协作任务。自适应系统中gpt-6.1-sol与opus-5.5分别完成28和27项，其他四模型至多3项，但典型任务耗时3.5小时、消耗2.18亿输入token。它揭示了多臂实时控制中速度、成本与可靠性的权衡。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal agents can now control robot arms by calling tools and writing code. Existing benchmarks fall short in three ways: most test one or two arms on short tasks, many pause the world while the agent thinks, and many give it ground-truth object positions. We present RoboTeam, a simulated benchmark where agents control 4 to 16 robot arms in real time from camera images alone. Its 36 tasks are long jobs that the arms must do together, such as passing timbers or building a picture from hundreds of cubes. We start from the most flexible agent system, the adaptive system, where one agent decides when to fork delegates. With it, gpt-6.1-sol and opus-5.5 complete 28 and 27 tasks, and four other models at most 3. But at a high price: a typical task takes gpt-6.1-sol 3.5 hours and 218 million input tokens, and a third of its steps fail at least once and must be retried. We then compare it with three fixed systems: single-agent, hierarchical, and decentralized. All four complete a similar number of tasks but differ in time and tokens. The hierarchical and decentralized systems are faster but use up to 1.9 times the tokens, and the single agent uses fewer tokens but takes 1.6 times as long, so the adaptive system lies between them. Even so, no model or system is yet fast, cheap, and reliable at once. RoboTeam measures these limits where earlier benchmarks cannot: long multi-arm jobs, camera images only, and a world that never pauses.

papers.authors: Ting-Hsuan Chen, Siheng Zhao, Han Jiang, Qi Pan, Louison Lu, Jiaheng Luo, Henghui Bao, Yiyu Chen, Quan Nguyen, Yue Wang
papers.evidence: 多类人机器人去中心化长时程协同
papers.tldr: 多机人形机器人协作需全身协调、长程规划与精确同步，现有方法难以去中心化扩展。Heave-Ho 用低层多智能体后训练适配人形基础跟踪模型，高层视觉语言规划器结合语音领导者-跟随者机制实现无网络通信同步。仅用两台同构机器人训练即可扩展到十台，并泛化到异构团队；在 HH-Bench 12 项任务和真实实验中稳定优于基线。该工作为去中心化长程多机人形 loco-manipulation 提供可扩展框架与基准。
papers.abstract_en: Collaboration promises to extend humanoid capabilities beyond what individual robots can achieve. However, realizing this potential requires coordinated whole-body interactions, coherent long-horizon planning, and precise synchronization across robots. We introduce Heave-Ho, a decentralized framework for long-horizon collaborative multi-humanoid loco-manipulation. At the low level, we develop a multi-agent post-training framework that adapts a humanoid foundation tracking model to physically coupled interactions between humanoids, enabling coordinated decentralized control from local observations alone. At the high level, we train a vision-language planner and design a speech-based leader-follower coordination mechanism to synchronize decentralized execution without network communication. Trained with two identical humanoids, our system scales to teams of up to ten robots and generalizes to heterogeneous teams without retraining. To benchmark these capabilities, we introduce HH-Bench, comprising 12 tasks involving teams of 2 to 10 humanoids, including heterogeneous teams. Systematic evaluations show that Heave-Ho consistently outperforms baseline methods, while real-world experiments demonstrate robust decentralized collaboration across challenging tasks.

papers.title_en: Constructive Infinitely Differentiable Guidance Vector Fields for Robotic Control
papers.authors: Vinicius Mariano Goncalves, Peilin Wu, Adriano Rezende, Weijia Yao
papers.evidence: 用于多机器人运动协调与路径跟随的引导向量场
papers.tldr: 制导向量场广泛用于机器人路径跟踪与多机器人协调，但现有方法常不可微或导数过大，难以嵌入需要制导信号导数的级联控制器。本文提出一种可构造的无限可微制导向量场，引入平滑参数并在其趋于零时退化为原方法。该方法实现简单高效，离散化后仍保持平滑，并能以更少曲线采样降低计算量且维持较小跟踪误差。理论性质与数值、实机实验共同验证了其有效性和实用价值。
papers.abstract_en: Guidance vector fields (GVFs) are a popular framework for tasks such as robotic path-following and multi-robot motion coordination, but existing approaches may be non-differentiable or have large derivatives, limiting their use in controllers that require derivatives of the guidance signal, which is common when the GVF is used as an input in a cascaded controller. This paper proposes an infinitely differentiable constructive GVF. The resulting vector field depends on a smoothing parameter and is a generalization of [1], recovering the original GVF in the limit as this parameter approaches zero. It also admits a simple and efficient implementation that preserves smoothness under discretization and can reduce computation time by using substantially fewer curve samples while maintaining small path-following errors. We establish the main theoretical properties and demonstrate its practical advantages through numerical and real-world experiments.

papers.title_en: DGF-Asym: Adaptive Peer Weighting for Collective Estimation under Noisy and Faulty Sensing
papers.authors: Mohammad Nomaan Husain, Tanja Katharina Kaiser
papers.evidence: 多机器人去中心化集体估计与自适应同伴加权
papers.tldr: 在不可靠感知下，机器人需要在自身观测与同伴信息之间自适应权衡。作者提出DGF-Asym，在DeGroot-Friedkin模型上引入基于回溯预测表现的非对称同伴加权，无需先验噪声统计与显式故障模型，并保持异步通信。仿真群体导航中，该方法估计更稳定、更可靠地维持决策准则，但决策时间变长。结果说明自适应同伴加权可用于无模型的稳定集体估计。
papers.abstract_en: Collective estimation under unreliable sensing requires robots to adaptively balance personal observations and social information from peers. We propose DGF-Asym, a decentralized collective estimation method extending the DeGroot-Friedkin model with asymmetric peer weighting based on retrospective predictive performance. The method supports consensus formation without prior sensor-noise statistics or explicit fault models while keeping inter-robot communication asynchronous. We evaluate DGF-Asym in simulated collective navigation under noisy observations and time-varying sensor faults. Compared with three baselines, it produces more stable estimates and more reliably sustains the decision criterion, at the cost of longer decision times. However, overall performance depends on fault ratio, group size, and influence-threshold selection. Our results demonstrate the potential of adaptive peer weighting for stable model-free collective estimation under unreliable sensing.

papers.title_en: Byzantine Resilience of Robot Gathering under Round-Robin Scheduling
papers.authors: Fabian Frei, Yuichi Sudo, Koichi Wada
papers.evidence: 拜占庭故障下的多机器人聚集协调
papers.tldr: 在轮询调度和刚性移动模型下，匿名遗忘机器人需要在存在拜占庭故障时完成平面聚集。论文分析简单算法ToMax：机器人移向多重性最大的位置，仅当自身位置为唯一最大点时静止。作者证明故障数满足f≤⌊√n/2⌋时，所有正确机器人能在有限时间聚集并永久保持。该结果给出Ω(√n)的拜占庭韧性下界，表明简单局部规则也具有强鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: We study deterministic gathering of $n$ anonymous, oblivious mobile robots in the plane under round-robin scheduling with rigid movement, in the presence of $f$ Byzantine robots. Robots observe all robot positions with their multiplicities, while their local coordinate systems may change adversarially between activations. The goal is for all correct robots to gather at a single point in finite time and remain there forever. We analyze ToMax, a simple algorithm that moves to a point of maximum multiplicity and stays still if and only if its current position is the unique maximum. We prove that ToMax achieves gathering whenever $f\le\lfloor\sqrt{n}/2\rfloor$, establishing an $Ω(\sqrt{n})$ lower bound on the achievable Byzantine resilience.

papers.authors: Matthew Groholski, Weiwei Gu, Nakul Gopalan
papers.evidence: 面向动态多智能体任务分配的对话增强贝叶斯框架
papers.tldr: 多智能体协作需在目标与职责变化时动态分配任务，但现有方法常假设目标静态、完全可观测，或仅依赖LLM而缺少可验证信念。本文提出通信增强的贝叶斯任务分配框架，让智能体通过对话降低对环境与协作者的不确定性，并以显式概率信念支撑决策。在动态到达任务的Overcooked全/部分可观测实验中，该智能体均优于普通LLM智能体；部分可观测且任务复杂时，比非通信基线平均快0.585、少用18个时间步。结果表明对话通信能提升部分可观测下的动态任务分配效率。
papers.abstract_en: Effective multi-agent collaboration requires agents to adapt task allocation as goals and responsibilities evolve. Prior task-allocation frameworks often assume static goals, full observability, or rely on large language models (LLMs) without explicit, verifiable beliefs about task allocation or intent. These assumptions limit their applicability to real-world collaboration, where agents often lack full information about each other's actions, progress, or local environment. To support dynamic task allocation under partial observability, we introduce a communication-augmented Bayesian task-allocation framework. Our agent uses dialogue to reduce uncertainty about the environment and collaborators, while keeping decisions grounded in explicit probabilistic beliefs. We evaluate our framework in an Overcooked domain extended with dynamically arriving tasks under both full and partial object-space observability. Our communication agent consistently outperforms a vanilla LLM agent in both settings. Additionally, our framework performs comparably to a non-communicating task-allocation baseline under full observability, but substantially outperforms it under partial observability as task complexity increases by an average speed up of 0.585 and completes on average 18 timesteps faster. These results indicate that our agent is more efficient in dynamic task allocation than baselines in partially observable environments, and that communication is important as available information decreases.
